title: Brief & development
description: Send a sketch, mood board or tech pack. We check construction, fabric and fit, then return a costing and open questions.

title: Sampling
description: Pattern, proto, fit and salesman samples from our own sample room. Fabric and trims from approved mills.

title: Bulk production
description: Cut, sewn and pressed on our own lines. Weekly progress photos and line reports.

title: Inspection
description: Inline and final inspection to AQL 1.0 or 2.5. Third-party inspection welcome.

title: Packing & shipping
description: Packed to your carton and labelling spec. FOB Hai Phong, or door to door to Rotterdam, Hamburg or Antwerp via your forwarder.
